verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an 'AI insights' analytics feature that shows what visitors ask and how AI Assistant answers using site content, plus an AI documentation agent that identifies outdated content and drafts improvements — both are AI-generated insights/suggestions surfaced inside the product. Evidence is vendor-documented only, without independent hands-on corroboration of accuracy or usefulness. missing for 10: independent/community validation of AI insights quality, more detail on suggestion actionability beyond docs pages.
